title: •Seeking An Audience
caption: •Seeking An Audience (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, while You Can Either Profit By This... or Or Be Destroyed on table, may ▼ one C-3PO, Chewie, Lando, Leia, or R2-D2. Once per game, may place this Effect out of play to take a character from Lost Pile into hand. {alter}
lore: “With your wisdom, I’m sure that we can work out an arrangement which will be mutually beneficial and enable us to avoid any unpleasant confrontation.”

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Margin credits printed vertically beside the slip: left 'Original concept by Brian Fred', right '2002 DPC Chicago Runner-Up' (margin_left / margin_right as vs3/25). The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. The crop shows a stray glyph tail above the heading (bottom of the previous slip's number), not part of the title. Base card is from Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (Oct 2000): lore corrected from scan — curly double quotes around the quote and curly apostrophe in I’m (wiki has straight single quotes). Copyright line read off the 350 px scan as the SE-style form '© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' (year read as 2000, consistent with the Oct 2000 release; low-res). Modern: V1-L-seekinganaudience.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 remake); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
